source: intents.near token_diff swaps on frozen chain days (data/chain)

nearMisses.missed: 2 days at the new rate (7 needed), 8 days from the old rate to the new (at most 7)

notMeasured: No fee change passes the PREREG.md section 3 rules in the 34 frozen days: a frontend must hold one rate for 7 days, then another rate at least 5 bps away for 7 days.
notRun: E1, E2 and their checks: no estimate without at least 3 usable fee changes (PREREG.md section 3)
